input.query: send verification email for changed email address link

candidates.explanation: The link in the new-email verification mail is built with '/confirm-email', the same frontend route as the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp). That page posts the hash to auth/email/confirm, which calls AuthService.confirmEmail. That method needs the user to be inactive and ignores newEmail, so the email change is never applied. The change-email flow should point to a separate route, e.g. '/confirm-new-email'. That route would call POST auth/email/confirm/new, which is handled by AuthService.confirmNewEmail.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, build the URL with the frontend domain + '/confirm-new-email' instead of '/confirm-email'. The frontend route must exist and call POST /auth/email/confirm/new.
